fact: A PUMA receiving station for Meteosat Second Generation data, installed at Maya-Maya international airport, Brazzaville, was inaugurated by Prime Minister Isidore Mvouba at the opening of the 6th EUMETSAT User Forum in Africa, per EUMETSAT's report.
The African Union Commission's ClimSA deck lists Congo among 41 of 49 member states with a PUMA station installed as at 12 May 2026; the station carries satellite imagery.
